0022600090.text: The New Orleans Pelicans open their 2026-27 season at home against the Indiana Pacers, who have also not yet played this season. The teams split their two meetings in 2025-26, and the most recent matchup was a 127-119 Pelicans loss in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026. For Indiana, Johnny Furphy is out after knee surgery, while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring), Jarace Walker (undisclosed) and T.J. McConnell (undisclosed) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
